name: gulliver_model_create

name: daedalus_model_generate
description: Queue local image-to-3D: trellis uses four GPUs; triposr is a single-GPU vertex-colored draft. Both preserve results as separate versions. Returns a job ID; inspect actual status, memory and geometry.

draft_resolution.description: TripoSR mesh grid only; not TRELLIS resolution.

draft_gpu.description: Physical GPU index for the draft; obtains a Hub lease.

source_job_id.description: Optional completed version of the SAME image, retained as comparison parent. Creates new geometry; never overwrites the source.

name: daedalus_model_refine
description: Create a separate refined version. Choose backend explicitly: UltraShape is image-guided, DetailGen is the legacy default. Compare the result through comparison_url; improvement is not guaranteed.

name: daedalus_jobs_list

name: daedalus_model_repair
description: Queue CPU mesh repair as a preserved new version: voxel volume reconstruction or classic cleanup and boundary/intersection repair. Inspect processing.closure_verified and topology; thickness/supports still need slicer review.
